reviewed_by: Claude #1097 parity implementer; defects independently validated by a separate Claude validator (issues/parity/validation.md, Core's own subagent events through the real ApiClient and reducer); an independent diff review is still required before merge
reason: GUI parity for #1097. (1) Stop subagent was gated on status === 'running', but Core marks a Claude task stoppable while queued, running or streaming (harnesses.py _claude_task_event) and every TaskProgressMessage turns a task into 'streaming', so Stop vanished at the first progress update and never showed for a queued task. The gate is now subagentStoppable(item): an active Core status and Core's stoppable flag not false; the status check matters because Core's stop record carries only task_id and the reducer merges payloads, leaving a stale stoppable=true on a cancelled task. (2) The artifact inspector never sent Core's continuation cursors: search offered only a 'More matches are available with the continuation cursor' note, and read mapped only continuation.starting_line, so a page that stopped inside a long line (>~8 KiB) had no next control. readToolOutput now accepts and maps continuation_cursor; the inspector offers More matches (appending pages for the query that produced them) and Continue line N / Read next lines. Selected: vitest for the stoppable rule over Core-shaped events through ApiClient + reducer, the client cursor mapping and paging helpers, and the existing harnessActivity reducer tests; Playwright: the activity-ledger area (whose entry actions host both controls), extended with the two new 'GUI parity' journeys, on desktop, 320 px Chromium and 390 px WebKit.
exclusions: No Core or Python source changes; Core's stop route, stoppable flag and tool-output read/search cursors are unchanged and covered by tests/v3/test_automation_runtime.py and the harness tests, which this diff does not touch. ChatResults' one-page excerpt and the terminal are unchanged. checkpoint_rewind stays disabled and untouched. The butler-workflow-registry.json change only updates the UI API call inventory count. No native changes. Other Playwright areas that list SessionsPage.tsx do not exercise subagent controls or the artifact inspector; compact/wide/other mobile profiles are excluded to keep CI narrow.
